items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: With Mr. Jefferies we played in the auditorium and he gave me a lot of good points.

ctx.x: We're playing dances now, you know. With Mr. Jefferies we played in the auditorium and he gave me a lot of good points. I'll never forget him as long as I live. And, of course, that was the marching thing, as you know. And, no matter what I had to say, I still marched with ... that we were marching. But, it was a good band. We had to march under the damnedest circumstances.
Well, I mean that was all very good to have as a musician whether you liked it or not.
